sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash-VL model card
sources.evidence: Exact VL card states 124B total and 5.5B active parameters, image/video inputs, text generation, 256K context, a 42-layer 5:1 KDA/Gated-MLA MoE backbone, ViT and two-layer MLP projector. MIT metadata; thinking and tool parsers documented.

sources.title: Ling model guide and named comparison table, updated October 19, 2026
sources.evidence: Later first-party comparison explicitly labels VL 124B/5.5B and 256K, separately from text Flash 124B/5.1B and Ling 3.1 Flash 560B/25B. Calls Ling an Ant Group model series and names Inclusion AI as its open-source community.

sources.title: Ant Ling platform changelog
sources.evidence: September 4, 2026 v2.0.3 explicitly launched Ling-3.0-flash-VL for online chat and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API calls. Full current HTML fetched successfully via HTTPS after web extraction timed out.

sources.title: Exact BF16 VL checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: BailingMoeV3VLForConditionalGeneration; 42 text layers, 512 experts with top-8 routing, first two layers dense, hidden size 2560, max_position_embeddings 131072, tie_word_embeddings false; 27-layer vision tower; no quantization configuration.

sources.title: Exact BF16 checkpoint index and 64 referenced shard headers
sources.evidence: All 64 shard headers fetched with bounded HTTP byte ranges and cross-checked against all 62,563 indexed tensor names. 124,848,460,496 stored elements: 124,848,295,536 BF16 and 164,960 F32. Includes vision/projector and separate embedding/head, no exported MTP layer. Index total_size is inconsistent with actual tensor bytes and was not used as a parameter count.

sources.title: inclusionAI BailingMoeV3 implementation
sources.evidence: VL uses this text backbone. A_log, dt_bias and expert_bias are declared nn.Parameter; expert_bias has default requires_grad=True and is supplied as routing score correction. This inference code alone does not establish gradient-based training provenance of routing correction state.

sources.title: inclusionAI exact VL implementation
sources.evidence: Exact VL class combines BailingMoeV3 language model, visual tower and two-layer projector. Supports image and video processing and maps the indexed linear_proj tensors. Confirms text-backbone implementation linkage.

sources.title: Multimodal Understanding API tutorial
sources.evidence: Explicitly assigns text/image/video input to Ling-3.0-flash-VL. Audio inputs are assigned to the distinct Ming-3.0-audio-flash model; examples confirm image_url and video_url routes for VL.

sources.title: Ling-3.0-VL public training-content summary, version 1.0
sources.publisher: Ant Intelligence (Hang Zhou) Technology Co., Ltd
sources.evidence: September 24 disclosure identifies exact Ling-3.0-flash-VL, gives September 8 Union-market placement, marks text/image/video but not audio training, and says the model outputs text. Region-specific placement is later than September 4 public platform launch.

sources.title: Ant Ling September 8 open-weight announcement, official X embed endpoint
sources.evidence: First-party oEmbed response reproduces AntLingAGI post dated September 8, 2026 announcing open-sourcing exact VL in BF16 and FP8. Direct x.com rendering returned 403; official embed was successfully fetched.

sources.title: Official model repository commit history
sources.evidence: Initial repository and weight upload commits are September 4. September 10 entries are README updates, including a context correction. Upload history alone does not prove visibility at upload time; the independent official platform changelog establishes September 4 public model availability.

sources.title: Small checkpoint training-argument metadata
sources.evidence: 26,757-byte metadata archive inspected with zipfile and pickletools without executing pickle. Shows untied embeddings, training mtp_num_layers=1, expert bias enabled and bias update rate 0.0. Exported safetensors contain no MTP layer; metadata is not added to learned parameter totals.

name.note: Display normalization of official Ling-3.0-flash-VL; exact VL variant.

developer.note: Official inclusionAI publisher; Ant Group Ling team. Legal provider named separately in training disclosure.

family.note: Official documentation places this exact VL model in the Ling series.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit first-party public availability is September 4 platform chat/API launch. September 8 is open-weight announcement and Union placement; September 10 is a later card edit, not initial release.

open_weights.note: Public BF16 checkpoint and official open-weight announcement verified.

license.note: Exact official repository model-card metadata explicitly declares MIT. No separate license file is listed.

parameters_b.note: Developer-stated nominal total in billions, confirmed by later named comparison. Complete BF16 header inventory has 124.848460496B elements, including 0.415893744B vision encoder and 0.0183552B projector; untied embedding/head are each 0.40239104B. No MTP weights or quantization metadata are exported. 0.00002048B routing expert_bias elements are inference Parameters but training provenance is not established; excluding these possible correction-state elements yields 124.848440016B. Neither precise number replaces the nominal specification.

active_parameters_b.note: Exact VL nominal active count, not text Flash 5.1B or 3.1 Flash 25B. Config routes top-8 of 512 experts. Header algebra with top-8 experts, one input-embedding row, full output head and vision modules gives about 5.538B, consistent with the nominal value; this is not a measured every-output-token execution count because vision runs during input processing.

architecture.note: Sparse MoE with 42 text layers: 35 KDA and 7 Gated MLA (5:1); first two FFNs dense, then 512 routed experts/top-8 plus a shared expert. 27-layer ViT, two-layer MLP projector and VideoRoPE form the multimodal extension.

context_window.note: Official supported 256K context; card supplies exact 262144-token launch with YaRN factor 2 over config base 131072. Older 1M card text was corrected September 9–10; no 1M transfer from text Flash or 3.1.

modalities.note: Official API explicitly supports text/images/video and training disclosure identifies text output. No audio capability assigned to this VL model; shared generic repository helpers do not establish extra modalities.

reasoning.note: Thinking enabled by default and can be disabled with enable_thinking false; official guide calls this hybrid reasoning.

tool_call.note: Exact card documents ling3 tool-call parser and automatic tool choice; official guide describes cross-tool GUI and MCP use.

description.value: Native multimodal hybrid MoE model for image and video understanding, reasoning, and visual agents
description.note: Supported by exact card and first-party API/architecture documentation; no benchmark superiority claim added.

patch.notes: 124B total and 5.5B active are developer nominal specifications. The full BF16 checkpoint contains 124.848460496B tensor elements, including a 0.415893744B vision encoder and 0.0183552B projector; 0.00002048B routing correction elements are not conclusively classified as gradient-learned weights. No MTP weights are exported. Supported 262144 context uses YaRN over a 131072 config base. Public API/chat launch was September 4, 2026; open-weight announcement followed September 8.

checkpoint_accounting.method: Each shard: 8-byte little-endian header length then bounded JSON header range; no weight payload download. Every index name and shard assignment cross-checked. Small pure_common.pt contains only metadata, inspected without unpickling.
checkpoint_accounting.learned_count_limit: Inference implementation registers all 110 F32 tensors as Parameters, including routing correction biases; actual gradient-training semantics of expert_bias remain unresolved. Keep published nominal total in catalog.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Correct release from September 10 to explicit September 4 public chat/API launch; add exact-model nominal 124B total, 5.5B active and MoE architecture. Preserve MIT/open weights, 256K context, text/image/video input, text output, reasoning/tool use and description. Full bounded-header reconciliation separates vision/projector, untied weights and absent exported MTP; 20,480 routing correction elements remain semantically ambiguous, so no unsupported precise learned total replaces the nominal count.
